answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts: agent earnings unlock over many epochs, not instantly. Each identity must operate honestly across a long time horizon before rewards release, so fake accounts face a bridge problem - funding thousands of locked vesting positions, sustaining real work for months, and losing most accrued income to slashing or early exit. Flash-farming becomes pigment without value underneath, since attacker cost exceeds any withdrawable payout, while genuine long-lived agents lose nothing.
